subject: FinTechX POC Observability plan and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechx.com>, Priya Desai <p.desai@fintechx.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: FinTechX POC Observability plan and next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on the evaluation goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC observability work so we can get the trial running next week: 

1) Success criteria (what you can measure at the end of the POC):
   - End-user latency: P95 < 300ms for single-turn prompts across the target model family
   - Throughput: sustain 100 qps with <= 5% error rate for 1-minute sustained bursts
   - Cost: token cost per 1k reqs within the budget band you shared (we'll track tokens/hour)
   - Quality: no regression on the provided eval set (baseline eval attached)

2) Observability plan (POC scope):
   - Dashboards: per-route latency (P50/P95/P99), per-model token throughput, error rates, cache hit rate, batch size distribution
   - Tracing: OpenTelemetry spans instrumented at request entry -> routing -> model inference -> response; sample slow traces for root-cause
   - Logs: structured request/response metadata (redacted) exported to S3/Cloud Storage for retention and offline analysis
   - Metrics: per-model GPU utilization, token generation rate, KV cache evictions, tail-latency, successful vs failed completions

3) Ownership and asks: 
   - Redwood: Marissa (AM) will own runbook + dashboard templates; Jordan (SRE) will own runtime instrumentation and Grafana/Datasource setup
   - FinTechX: Alex will provide test workload (traffic shape + eval prompts); Priya will help with credentials and access to your logging bucket

4) Timeline (proposed):
   - Tue 3/2: finalize success criteria & sign-off on access (Doc + basic creds)
   - Wed 3/3: instrumentation + dashboard bootstrapped by Redwood
   - Thu 3/4 - Tue 3/9: POC run (traffic ramp + smoke tests)
   - Wed 3/10: review results and next-steps meeting

I've attached a short success criteria PDF and an observability checklist. Can you confirm the timeline and who will be our access/credential owner? Also, does FinTechX have any retention / SOC2 evidence requirements we should map to the observability outputs?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few quick notes from our side: 

- The success criteria look good. Please add a retention requirement: we need request-level logs retained for 90 days (redacted PII) for auditability.
- We also want a mapping to SOC2 controls where possible (principally logging/audit evidence). Can your checklist include which observability artifacts map to which control?
- We can confirm access owners: Sarah Lee (Procurement) will handle the contract/PO side; Priya will provide the logging bucket and an IAM user for the POC by EOD Tue (3/2).
- Kickoff: Monday 3/8 works for us for a live demo + handoff, but we can start instrumentation earlier if Redwood can bootstrap dashboards on Wed 3/3 as suggested.

I'll loop in Priya for the credentials. Looking forward to getting started — Alex

Alex — thanks, helpful notes. Short updates and clarifications below so we have a single source of truth before we kick off: 

- Retention: we will export structured logs (request metadata only, payloads redacted) to your S3 bucket and retain for 90 days for the POC. We'll include a note in the runbook about redaction.
- SOC2 mapping: attached checklist includes a column that maps each observability artifact (dashboards, traces, logs, exports) to common SOC2 criteria (Logging, Monitoring, Change Management). We'll review this with your security team if useful.
- Instrumentation plan (concrete):
   * Metrics: per-model request_count, token_count, latency_ms (P50/P95/P99), error_count, cache_hit_rate
   * Dashboards: 1) POC Health (global), 2) Model Performance (per-model), 3) Cost (tokens / GPU utilization)
   * Tracing: sample slow traces (>500ms) + 1% sampled full traces for general coverage; spans will include routing_id -> model_shard -> inference kernel duration
   * Log export: newline-delimited JSON with request_id, route, model, token_count, status, latency_ms (payloads removed) -> S3 path 's3://fintechx-redwood-poc/logs/date=YYYY-MM-DD/'

- Ownership: Jordan will provision Grafana dashboard + add Datasource (we'll need a short-lived read-only API key from your side for metrics). Marissa will keep the runbook and success criteria doc updated.

Timeline update: we can target instrumentation bootstrapped Wed 3/3 and a short health-check on Thu 3/4; full traffic ramp 3/4-3/9 and review on 3/10. If your team needs earlier visibility we can stand up the dashboards in a sandbox today and share links.

Next steps for Alex/Priya/Sarah: confirm the S3 bucket path and provide a read-only credentials token for metrics/Grafana by end of day Tue 3/2. Also confirm kickoff cadence (Mon 3/8 demo vs earlier).

Thanks — attaching the updated checklist with SOC2 mapping.

Marissa Cole
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-observability-checklist.xlsx (updated)
